In [[3645 BBY]],<ref name="time" /> the [[Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] convened to '''elect''' a [[Supreme Chancellor]] as leader of the democratic government<ref name="Holo" /> for a four-year term.<ref name="Gov">{{TORcite|type=codex|Republic Government}}</ref> The Senate unanimously elected Senator [[Dorian Janarus]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as the Supreme Chancellor<ref name="Holo" /> in [[3653 BBY]], and [[Supreme Chancellor election, 3649 BBY|re-elected]] him in [[3649 BBY]]. In 3645 BBY, at the next expiration of the four-year term, the Senate decided he should remain in the position.<ref name="time" /> Like the previous one, the election was a small affair because the candidates feared assassination by the [[Sith Empire]].<ref name="Gov">{{TORcite|type=codex|Republic Government}}</ref>
